description: China Eastern Eastern Miles for a China Eastern, Shanghai Airlines or China United ticket, from the fare plus the YQ fuel surcharge in yuan (CNY, whole ticket). Miles = fare x a coefficient by member level and sales channel (China Eastern app, website or 95530 / other channels: 1-star 0.264 / 0.24 up to Platinum 1.232 / 1.12), rounded down, no minimum. China Eastern does not say how a ticket in another currency is converted, so give the CNY amount. Progress toward the next level by yearly spend (2-star 3,000 up to Platinum 100,000 yuan; each level also needs qualifying segments or kilometres, named in the note); spend is the qualifying spend so far. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in CNY, not US dollars. Unofficial.

channel.description: Where the ticket was sold. OWN = China Eastern app, website or 95530 (higher coefficient); OTH = Any other channel (travel agents and other sellers). China Eastern pays a higher coefficient on its own channels.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of China Eastern's own: delta = Delta SkyMiles (creditStatus one of: SkyMiles Member, Silver Medallion, Gold Medallion, Platinum Medallion, Diamond Medallion); flying-club = Flying Club (creditStatus one of: Red, Silver, Gold); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

level.description: Your Eastern Miles level when you fly. S1 = 1-star member (coefficient 0.264 or 0.24); S2 = 2-star member (0.44 or 0.4); S3 = 3-star member (0.66 or 0.6); S4 = 4-star member (0.792 or 0.72); S5 = 5-star member (0.88 or 0.8); S6 = 6-star member (0.968 or 0.88); SV = Silver card (SkyTeam Elite, 1.056 or 0.96); GD = Gold card (SkyTeam Elite Plus, 1.144 or 1.04); PT = Platinum card (SkyTeam Elite Plus, 1.232 or 1.12).

price.description: Fare plus YQ (CNY, whole ticket) in CNY. In yuan: the ticket price including the YQ fuel surcharge, for the whole ticket. China Eastern does not say how a ticket in another currency is converted. Required unless creditTo is given.

spend.description: Qualifying spend so far in the 12 months (CNY, optional). Used only for the progress toward the next level.
